aws-lc-sys 0.23.1.why: build.rs compiles the bundled AWS-LC with CMake and emits cfg x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu (it selects the pre-generated bindings) and the link of libaws_lc_0_23_1_crypto. Replaced by buildrules//third_party/aws-lc:crypto, linked into each executable or test (native_deps). That AWS-LC is the same release (1.39.0) but its symbols are buildrules_awslc_X where the bindings say aws_lc_0_23_1_X, so the prefix in the bindings is rewritten (2579 occurrences, counted); the three ERR_GET_*_RUST C wrappers of rust_wrapper.c become the Rust expressions of the static inline functions they wrap.

aws-lc-rs 1.11.1.why: build.rs only re-exports the DEP_AWS_LC_* variables of aws-lc-sys to its dependents; it emits no cfg. aws-lc-sys has no build script run any more (above), so there is nothing to re-export, and the one script that depends on it (rustls: a probe for nightly-only read_buf) reads none of them.
